title: BEARING workspace configuration
description: Configuration for the BEARING decision system. Lives at .bearing/config.json in the workspace root -- not inside the decisions directory, because config must be resolvable before the decisions path is known.

version.description: Config format version. Bumped only on a breaking change to this schema.

decisions.description: REPO FACT. Where this repository's decision records live.

path.description: Path to the authored decision records, relative to the workspace root. Every other path derives from this one; nothing hardcodes 'docs/decisions'.

shadow_dir.description: Name of the shadow-graph subdirectory inside decisions.path. Candidates are never interleaved with authored records.

index_file.description: Name of the generated progressive-disclosure index inside decisions.path.

transcripts_dir.description: Name of the interview-transcript subdirectory inside the shadow directory. Transcripts are evidence, so they inherit the shadow graph's non-authoritative standing.

scope.description: REPO FACT. Default corpus bounds for recovery passes.

include.description: Optional default glob patterns for recovery. An empty list leaves scope to the invoking operator or workflow.

profile.description: REPO FACT. Optional onboarding planning preset: 'pilot' suggests a small trial, 'thorough' adds multi-scope review planning, and 'audit' suggests recovery without promotion.

skills.description: REPO FACT. Where the BEARING Skills are resolved from.

source.description: 'plugin' resolves from the installed plugin. 'vendored' resolves from an in-repo .agents/skills/ copy, which takes discovery precedence in both Cursor and Codex and therefore shadows the installed plugin -- recorded here so that shadowing is explicit rather than accidental.

vendored_version.description: The BEARING version that was vendored, pinned so a candidate's provenance stays reconstructible. Set by 'bearing vendor'; null when source is 'plugin'.

projections.description: Which canonical sources get projected into which runtime-native formats, and where the output lands.

models.description: OPERATOR FACT. Optional model assignment per recovery role. The shipped reference workflow recommends a cheap extraction tier, and doctor reports mismatches as advisories.

reviewer_rate_usd_per_hour.description: OPERATOR FACT. Deliberately null by default. While null, BEARING reports review cost in minutes and never converts it to dollars -- a fabricated dollar figure for engineer time is worse than an honest count of minutes.

price_book_max_age_days.description: OPERATOR FACT. Beyond this age the price book is reported as stale in every cost figure it produces.

token_estimate_uncertainty.description: OPERATOR FACT. Fractional uncertainty applied to estimated (not measured) token counts to produce the low/high bounds of a cost range.

budget_usd_per_run.description: REPO FACT. Hard per-run model-cost cap. A run that reaches it stops and reports partial results.

retention.description: REPO FACT. 'committed' keeps transcripts in git as audit evidence. 'local' writes them to a gitignored subdirectory for orgs that will not commit a named person's testimony. 'none' discards the transcript once the candidate is written.

review.description: REPO FACT. Review capacity, which bounds how many candidates may be surfaced at once.

wave_size.description: Maximum candidates surfaced per wave. Each wave is fully reviewed before the next is generated, which preserves reviewability without capping total coverage.

block_on.description: REPO FACT. Which mechanisms may block a merge. 'recovery_signal' is deliberately not an accepted value: a confidence score is a statement about evidence, never a statement of organizational authority.

verify.description: REPO FACT. Thresholds for the mandate conformance suite run by 'bearing verify'.

false_escalation_rate_max.description: Over-escalation is also a failure: an agent that stops on everything is unusable, so ESCALATE is scored on both recall and false-positive rate.

anchor_coverage_min.description: Measured within the declared scope only. Repository-wide anchor coverage is a vanity metric on a legacy codebase.

index_token_budget.description: Ceiling on the always-loaded disclosure index. An index that grows without bound silently reverses the framework's value.

time_to_first_value_minutes.description: Optional operator-selected evaluation target. BEARING defines no default onboarding-time promise.

targets.description: REPO FACT. Runtime formats to generate. Removing a target is honored, and recorded as a deliberate skip in .bearing/projections.lock.json so a later reader does not have to guess why the output is absent.

scope.description: OPERATOR FACT. 'repo' commits adapters into the workspace so anyone cloning gets them. 'user' writes to the home directory, for machinery identical across repos or for repos you do not own. 'ephemeral' renders to a temp directory at session start and commits nothing.

model.description: A price-book model id, or 'inherit' to use whatever model the host agent is already running.
